body:
## M1 batch complete: full battery results (record, not an approval request)

Stages M1a-M1f plus wrap-up executed in one autonomous pass per the batched execution mode (orchestrator + one subagent per stage, gates run and judged at the orchestrator level). Branch state: uncommitted on `feature/solver-rework-arch1-cutover`; the run now PAUSES for the user's commit.

### What was built

- `FoldReplayDriver` (fold + fixed-point driver: clamp-free disk solve with in-loop greedy chord-cut arc narrowing, pattern fold via the pattern-aware `JumpLinearModel` + `velocityWalls` + `keepAliveWall`, anchor margins, lexicographic SLP, free-start translation window, era-aware bucket walk + objective walk + window-scan leaf + ulp nudge, end polish, tail-gate enumeration; every round a replayable incumbent; `polishFromAnchor` for seeded polish).
- `WallHomotopyLadder` (rungs 0.05 / 0.01 / 0.002 / 0, warm-chained, incumbents always scored against the true spec; 2e-6 collision clearance on one-sided wall faces at the final rung, pad and range edges exempt).
- `AnchorSlp` (anchor-local signed margins + lexicographic SLP over `TrustRegionLp`; gate-band rows: legacy exact per-axis, modern supporting-hyperplane keep-alive plus per-axis-box-and-anchor-row zero side).
- `BucketWalk` (era-aware bucket indexing: `FacingLattice` legacy, `sinStep262` for 26.x; integer walk via LP relaxation + guided rounding with exact per-combo dp re-optimization; objective walk with adaptive budget; window-scan leaf capped to active-wall neighborhoods).
- `DiskSocpKernel` extended and hardened: native two-axis chord rows (`solveChords`), 12-attempt Cholesky jitter ladder, mu-reduction on factor failure with best-iterate snapshots, and a weak-duality infeasibility certificate (`FAIL_UNBOUNDED`).
- Engine wiring: `FoldDriverNode` is the primary recovery on both tiers (BnbNode stays as fallback until M2b), `HomotopyLadderNode` is the knife-edge / no-solution arm, driver rounds feed ClosestMiss and SolverTrace, deadlines respected at round and narrowing-iteration granularity, kernel-certified infeasibility routes to the no-solution flow, dF-chain specs decline gracefully to the existing nodes. Sphere-snap yaw-lock save/playback path untouched.
- Fixtures `captures/hpk_precise/` (PRECISE-spec knife-edge captures with bit-exact witness validation) and three new expects (below); TESTS.md updated.

### Battery results

All runs on this machine, 2026-08-27. Corpus = 126 captures + the 5 new rows; comparator = the committed STEP-9 method.

| Leg | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Full slow suite `-PslowTests` (includes the new expects and the determinism guards) | GREEN, 7 m 16 s |
| CorpusBench FAST vs STEP-9 OLD | GREEN: 0 feasibility regressions, 2 gains (loopmm-tight-t39, synth-legal-shortfall); objective 62 wins / 3 regressions / 44 ties; all 3 regressions pre-existing cutover dips (j1149 -6.0e-4, j318 -4.2e-4, gh386-j335 -2.2e-4); STEP-9's j003 -1.03 and taser-80t/j187 regressions are gone |
| CorpusBench FAST vs STEP-9 NEW (give-back) | GREEN with note: 0 feasibility regressions, 11 wins / 4 regressions / 95 ties; the 4 are the declared M1e dips (deserthard x2 -3.0e-4, j321 -1.8e-4, j001 -1.0e-4) traded against j003 +1.03 |
| CorpusBench THOROUGH-4s vs OLD | GREEN: 0 feasibility regressions, 2 gains (j1150-2x2bm hpk, synth-legal-shortfall); 28 wins / 7 regressions / 71 ties; STEP-9's three 4s budget-artifact feasibility failures are gone; j003 solves at 4s |
| TH10 suspect pass vs OLD TH10 | GREEN: equal-or-better on every suspect except j1149 (-6.3e-4, pre-existing); j021 reaches the 1067.8638 graph-path gate; j153's 4s dip is a budget artifact (M1 at 10s beats OLD at 4s by +4.4e-3) |
| Named targets | j003 FAST -31.299999992 at 0.9 s and THOROUGH-10s -31.299999974 in-deadline, the STEP-9 hang is gone; thousand THOROUGH-10s 6523.307713024 byte-exact; j1150-noturn-inner THOROUGH -2805.2952 (beats the p2 witness -2805.2990460856336); j154-noturn-ja-inner FAST -1599.7002134 (beats the in-game F3 witness -1599.7001161289918) |
| Determinism | GREEN (existing guards + engine-level FAST re-solve bit-identical + driver 5x bit-identical, all asserted) |
| Zero flags | GREEN (`grep -rn "pkc\." core/src/main` = `pkc.solver.trace` logging only) |
| FAST floor (109-jump STEP-9 basis) | RED: median 125 ms (target ~80, OLD 59), p90 539 (target 562, ok), sum 41.6 s (OLD 29.2). Floor recovery is structurally the M2b deletion item, as the definition of done anticipates; M1f's sound levers are exhausted (skipping ResidualRescue-on-feasible measured as objective give-back) |

New expects (all SlowSolverTests, sidecar-only, budget-variance-safe floors, byte-exact feasibility asserted exactly):

- `thousand-1-dup2.expect.json`: THOROUGH-10s, objective >= 6523.3076 (live 6523.3077130).
- `j1150-noturn-inner.expect.json`: THOROUGH-10s, objective >= -2805.2990460856336 (live -2805.2952).
- `j154-noturn-ja-inner.expect.json`: FAST, objective <= -1599.7001161289918 (live -1599.7002134).
- j003 keeps its existing expect; its objective/tier/deadline gates live in `FoldDriverEngineTest`.

### Declared judgment calls and measured deviations from the plan text

1. Gate re-sequencing inside the batch: M0's python driver ran chord narrowing in every leg (`--decode-mode chord` default), so the fold-alone stage gates (M1a thousand, M1b byte-exact closures) were never reachable as staged; each numeric gate was enforced at its earliest reachable stage and all were enforced before this post.
2. The M1b gate premise was measured false: every in-repo hpk capture already solves at FAST. The gate re-scoped to the measured return-nothing set; of it, loopmm-tight-t39 now solves byte-exact (feasibility gain above), nix-full-t1 stalls at 4.6e-5, and bfsetup2 is now kernel-CERTIFIED infeasible in the clamp-free model up to 0.05 relax (the old kernel fake-converged on it; whether it is byte-feasible at all is unestablished).
3. thousand's 6523.30772 plan value: measured reachable is 6523.3077130 (7e-6 short, a bucket-lattice local optimum stable at 20 s; box-corner multi-start measured worse). The expect asserts >= 6523.3076; the 6523.30772 value moves to M2a certification.
4. j1150 FAST witness-family reach: cross-basin (H2-consistent, measured at 50-bucket scan range); FAST holds -2805.2993795. M2a certification item; the THOROUGH expect covers the witness value.
5. j154 user ruling (2026-08-27): the X GE -1599.2 plate belongs at t34; the D2 value -1599.7237570 is spec-invalid (violates X@34 by 1.75e-2) and is dropped everywhere; the F3 decode is the witness (-1599.7001161289918, the in-game-verified number). The cold ladder beats it with zero human data (-1599.7001748).
6. SlpSolve default-seed switch (plan M1f item): built, measured harmful (j021 -2.0e-2 FAST plus latency), fully reverted. The sound part stands: driver incumbents flow ahead of SLP fallbacks, and the H3-unsound dual fallback is skipped on kernel-certified infeasibility. Final disposition at M2b.
7. Kernel finding: the pre-M1 kernel fake-converged on some infeasible specs (returned converged=true at values below any primal bound). The new weak-duality certificate makes GateMip's infeasibility certification sound.

### M2 carry-over list

M2a: certified arc + gate B&B (branch the same chord family); thousand 6523.30772 and j1150 FAST witness-family as certification targets; per-solve kernel cost at n=176 is the k-gon-on-measured-need trigger. M2b: delete subsumed recovery components per the inventory (BoundPrunedRecovery, SeamSweepRecovery, GateMip, RelaxationRecovery, SphereDecodeSnap, ResidualRescue), recover the FAST floor (the median 125 -> <= ~80 target and the released-59 G1 bar), SlpSolve seed disposition, net LOC reduction, one-path trace-shape test, OPTIMIZE gap contract, release-tag baselines for G1.

The run now HOLDS for the user's commit (touchpoint 1 of the batched execution mode).
